title: 00420 - P106B/004203
models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri/Connectors from/to Throttle Body Control Module to Engine Control Module faulty
Throttle Body Control Module Damaged and/or Moving Difficulties
stepByStepSolution:
Kontrol edin:  Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri/Connectors from/to Throttle Body Control Module to Engine Control Module
Kontrol edin:  for properly attached Connectors, twisted Pins, loose Contact, Corrosion and Water Ingress
Kontrol edin:  for properly attached Connectors, twisted Pins, loose Contact, Corrosion and Water Ingress
Kontrol edin:  Throttle Body Control Module for Damage and Moving Difficulties
technicalNotes:
When found on 3.0l CR-TDI (i.e. BKS/BUG) or 4.2l CR-TDI (BVN), the Learning Values have to be cleared after replacing the Throttle Body Control Module.
DO NOT CLEAR LEARNED VALUES IF YOU HAVE NOT REPLACED THE THROTTLE BODY CONTROL MODULE! Otherwise the proper values are being cleared and incorrect values are being learned.
